resources.string: Fakahu ha \'aho Hijri ke ma\'u \'a e \'Alafa, \'Ani-Nahr mo e ngaahi \'aho \'o e Tashreeq .
Fakahu ha \'aho Hijri ke vakai ki he \'Alafa, \'Ani-Nahr mo e ngaahi \'aho \'o e Tashreeq .
Fakahu ha ʻaho Hijri ʻoku ʻaonga. Ta\'u mei he 1300 ki he 1600, mahina mei he 1 ki he 12, \'aho mei he 1 ki he 30.

Fakahu ha \'aho Hijri (pe tauhi \'a e \'aho lolotonga) ke ma\'u \'i he taimi pe ko ia \'a e ngaahi \'aho \'o e Hajj \'o hono ta\'u: \'Aho \'o e \'Alafa (9 Dhul-Hijjah), \'Aho \'o e An-Nahr (10 Dhul-Hijjats) mo e ngaahi \'aho \'o e Tashreeq (11, 12 mo e 13 Dhul ijjah), mo e 13 Dhul-Hijjah). tuʻunga ʻo fakatatau ki ho ʻaho.
Me\'a fakafuofua \'o e ngaahi \'aho \'o e Hajj
Ko e pou lahi taha: tuʻu ʻi Arafah mei he hili ʻa e hoʻataá ʻo aʻu ki he tō ʻa e laʻaá, ʻo fai ha kole lahi, takbir mo e tahlil. Na\'e pehe \'e he Palofita (PBUH): "Ko e Hajj ko e Arafah."
Eid al-Adha: maka Jamarat al-Aqabah mo e ngaahi makamaka \'e fitu, \'oatu \'a e feilaulau, tafi pe teuteu\'i, pea fakahoko \'a e Tawaf \'o e \'Ifadah mo e Sai.
ʻAho ʻo ʻAna-Naha (10 ʻo e ʻaho ʻo e ʻAho-Hija)
Ko ha fakatokanga fakaʻaho ʻokú ne fakamanatu atu ʻa e ouau ʻoku fakataumuʻá ʻi hono taimí lolotonga e ngaahi ʻaho ʻo e Hajj (8–13 Dhul-Hijjah)
Ko ha fakatokanga fakaʻaho ʻokú ne fakamanatu atu ʻa e ouau ʻoku fakataumuʻá ʻi hono taimí lolotonga e ngaahi ʻaho ʻo e Hajj (8–13 Dhul-Hijjah)

Ko e sunnah \'o e \'aho ni: hū ki he ihram, \'ulu ki Mina pea fakamoleki \'a e po \'i ai, \'o toutou fai \'a e Talbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk", pea lotu \'i ai fakanounou\'i \'o \'ikai fakataha\'i.
ʻAho ʻo Tawia (8 ʻo e ʻAho-Hija)

Makaʻi ʻa e Jamarat ʻe tolu hili ʻa e hoʻataá: ʻa e siʻisiʻí, pea ʻi he lotolotongá, pea ʻi he lahí, ʻa e ngaahi foʻi maka ʻe fitu takitaha lolotonga ʻene leaʻaki ʻa e takbir, ʻo kolekole hili ʻa e fanga kiʻi maka iiki mo e lotolotongá.
Ngaahi ʻaho ʻo e Tasiliki: ʻaho 1 (11 ʻo e ʻaho ʻo e ʻaho ʻo e ʻaho ʻo e ʻaho ʻo e ʻaho)

Toe maka\'i \'a e Jamarat \'e tolu hili \'a e ho\'ata \'o hange ko \'aneafi. Ko ia ‘okú ne loto ke fakavavevavé ‘e lava ke ne mavahe mei Mina ki mu‘a ke tō ‘a e la‘aá; ko ia \'oku nofo \'oku ne fakamoleki \'a e po mo e maka \'i he \'aho hono tolu.
Ngaahi ʻaho ʻo e Tasiliki: ʻaho 2 (12 ʻo e ʻaho ʻo e ʻaho ʻo e ʻaho ʻo e ʻaho ʻo e ʻaho 2)
Maka \'a e Jamarat \'e tolu hili \'a e ho\'ata, pea faka\'osi \'a e Hajj \'aki \'a e Tawaf fakamavae \'i he taimi \'oku mavahe ai mei Makkah. Fakatauange ke tali \'e Allah ho\'o Hajj.
Ngaahi ʻaho ʻo e Tasiliki: ʻaho 3 (13 ʻo e ʻaho ʻo e ʻAho-Hija)

Ko ha fakamatala kakato ki he Hajj mo e Umrah: faka\'uhinga mo e ngaahi tu\'utu\'uni, \'a e fa\'ahinga \'o e ngaahi ouau, \'a e mawaqit, \'a e ngaahi ouau \'i he sitepu ki he sitepu mo honau poto mo e me\'a ke lea\'aki \'i he tu\'unga takitaha, \'a e ngaahi tapu \'o e ihram, mo e ngaahi kole. Fili ʻa e konga ʻokú ke fie fakatotoloʻí.

Ko hono ngaahi tu\'unga, nisab mo e ngaahi fa\'ahinga \'e valu \'o e kau ma\'u .
\'Oku \'ikai ha hingoa \'oku fe\'unga mo ho\'o fekumi

Naʻe pehē ʻe he Palōfita صلى الله عليه وسلم: “ʻOku hivangofulu mā hiva ʻa e hingoa ʻo ʻAlá, ʻoku siʻi hifo ʻi he taha ʻe teau; ko ia te ne lau kinautolú te ne hū ki Palataisi.” Tap ha hingoa ke lau hono fakamatala kakato, \'uhinga mo e fakamo\'oni mei he Quran.
